## Consolidate & convert to units
**Runs:** Monday 07:00

Every sold and stocked code is resolved against the Base to its **component** and multiplied into units:

| Type | Meaning | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Cx | box | `Qtd Cx` |
| Jg | set | `Qtd Jg` |
| Comp | kit composition | `Qtd Comp` |
| Dec | decorated variant | 1 |
| Un | unit (or not in Base) | 1 |

`On` = units sold through online channels (`numeroLoja` filled). `Media M` = monthly average over the 3-month window, rounded up.

### ⚠️ Portfolio copy - credentials not connected
This is a sanitized export of a workflow running in production.
Credentials, spreadsheet IDs and e-mail addresses were intentionally removed
or replaced with placeholders, so credential warnings on nodes are expected.
See the README for setup instructions.
